Who it is for

PCS and UPSC aspirants who want the official version of a scheme rather than a magazine's summary.

Buy it if

You are preparing for a state or civil services paper that asks about schemes and governance.

Avoid it if

You only need the month's headlines - the free current affairs section here covers that.

How to use it

Do not read it cover to cover: index the topics your syllabus names and read only those entries.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • Written by the departments responsible for the schemes
  • The reference exam questions are actually set from

Cons

  • Not a book to read cover to cover
  • Annual - last year's copy ages quickly

Topics covered

  • Government schemes
  • Ministries
  • Statistics
  • State of the union
